LanguageData.NR_DiveActTip_Hack: Break the gate or ICE ahead.
LanguageData.NR_DiveActTip_Exit: Leave through the I/O port with everything you took.
LanguageData.NR_DiveActTip_Retreat: Leave now. From the lobby it is free; deeper in, half the haul is lost and Netsick grows.

LanguageData.NR_ProgramDesc_Shield: Absorbs one Black ICE strike. Costs {0} cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_ProgramDesc_Decoy: 50% to draw off one ICE strike. Costs {0} cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_ProgramDesc_Stealth: Half the trace for the whole dive. Costs {0} cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_ProgramDesc_Killer: Breaks one gate or ICE without a roll. Costs {0} cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_DiveHiddenAhead: something hidden ahead: scan it first
LanguageData.NR_DiveBlocked: the way is blocked: hack it first
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogTimeout: Too long in the net: the node threw you out. The netrunner is unconscious.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogLockOut: Black ICE locked {0} out of the net.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogComa: Black ICE put {0} into a coma.
LanguageData.NR_DiveDone: {0} finished the dive into {1}. Haul: {2}. Trace: +{3} Heat.
LanguageData.NR_DiveAborted: The dive was cut: the netrunner is no longer in the cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayPickNode: Pick a node to read it.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayNodeHidden: This node is hidden. A honeypot trace can reveal it.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayNoPod: needs a runner: a colonist with a cyberlink in a powered cyberpod
LanguageData.NR_GatewayHiddenRow: ? hidden node (found by a honeypot trace)
LanguageData.NR_GatewayDiveTip: {0} dives from the cyberpod. The game stays paused while you play the dive.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayRisk_0: low: weak gates, no Black ICE
LanguageData.NR_GatewayRisk_1: medium: strong gates and a fork; the hard path is guarded by Black ICE
LanguageData.NR_GatewayRisk_2: high: Black ICE (nausea, lockout or coma); a failed dive leaves burns
LanguageData.NR_GatewayTipType: What kind of node it is: it decides the haul and how loud a dive is.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayTipDefense: Code gates to break on the way in; the level makes each one harder.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayTipIce: White ICE only blocks. Black ICE strikes the netrunner when you get close and fail.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayTipReward: What downloading the files and the memory unit can give.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayTipTrace: Heat added per network action, before program and coprocessor modifiers.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayTipRisk: Grey: low. Yellow: medium, the risk is on the hard path. Red: Black ICE; its strikes use Hacking Expansion outcomes, and a failed dive burns the runner.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayZoomReset: Reset zoom and position (or click the middle mouse button on the field). Drag the field with the mouse to move it.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogSpecial: Something special was waiting at the exit.
LanguageData.NR_ExtNodeReward_CorpCore: a daemon or a rare unique recording, sometimes an AI core module, lots of data
LanguageData.NR_BossNode: {0} has surfaced in the Gateway for {1} days: top defense, strong Black ICE, and a reward worth the risk.
LanguageData.NR_FindResearch: Research data from the net: {0} moved forward.
LanguageData.NR_FindFixerService: {0} owes you a favor: one free scrub of {1} Heat (Club).
LanguageData.NR_FindGroupFavor: A hacker group noticed your work. Favor: {0}/{1}.
LanguageData.NR_CelebrityEventDark: the last minutes before the end
LanguageData.NR_AlliesCooldown: the group can help again in {0}
LanguageData.NR_AlliesNoFaction: No allied faction can come, so the hacker group sent data instead.
LanguageData.NR_DaemonDesc_Blade: Hacking +30% in every dive, without the Sword's double trace.
LanguageData.NR_DaemonDesc_Aegis: One Shield charge in every dive.
LanguageData.NR_DaemonDesc_Wraith: Half the trace in every dive, like Stealth. The node alert needs one more failure to wake the patrol.
LanguageData.NR_DaemonDesc_Hound: One Killer charge in every dive.
LanguageData.NR_DaemonDesc_Lens: Hidden caches are visible from the start.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogHoneypotFound: Deep scan: this node is bait. The rich files are a trap.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogHunterHolds: The ICE hunter shrugged off the attack.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogHunter: An ICE hunter has picked up your trail.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogRival: A rival netrunner is in the node: {0} turns before the files are gone.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogRivalTook: The rival got to the files first.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogHoneypot: Bait! The files were half empty and the trace flared up.
LanguageData.NR_WildAI: Something lives in the memory unit: a wild AI, half-formed, curious and afraid.
LanguageData.NR_WildAITame: Tame it (an AI fragment, a little trace)
LanguageData.NR_WildAISell: Sell it ({0} silver, the buyers talk)
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogWildTamed: The wild AI followed you into a fragment.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogWildErased: The wild AI is gone; its memory is yours.
LanguageData.NR_HunterFollowedLog: An ICE hunter followed the trail home
LanguageData.NR_HunterFollowed: The ICE hunter followed your netrunner back. Expect trouble with the machines soon.
LanguageData.NR_Storm: A data storm sweeps the net for {0}: every node is harder to crack, and every haul is bigger.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayRivalTip: Another netrunner is after this node: you have {0} turns before the files are gone.
LanguageData.NR_DiveHunterActive: ICE hunter on your trail: it strikes every node turn. Hack it when nothing blocks the way.
LanguageData.NR_DiveStorm: Data storm: stronger defenses, bigger haul
LanguageData.NR_ReportSpecial: ★ A special find on the exit.
LanguageData.NR_ReportLost: Lost on the way out: {0} cyberdata, {1} advanced, {2} silver, {3} items.
LanguageData.NR_ReportHunterValue: followed the trace: a breakdown on the map within 6-12 hours
LanguageData.NR_ReportEventHunter: An ICE hunter came after the netrunner.
LanguageData.NR_ReportEventRival: A rival netrunner took the files first.
LanguageData.NR_ReportEventStorm: A data storm: harder gates, bigger haul.
LanguageData.NR_ReportEventCounterHack: Counter-hack done: the turrets are back.
LanguageData.NR_ReportSettingHint: This summary can be turned off in the mod settings.
LanguageData.NR_DiveHudTraceTip: Every action raises the dive's trace; on leaving it becomes Heat. Stealth and the Wraith halve it.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayHomeTip: Your home hub: back to the navigation screen.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogPassage: A hidden passage: the haul grows by ×{0}.
LanguageData.NR_DiveBranchHardDesc: More loot and an extra cache, but Black ICE guards it and the trace is louder.
LanguageData.NR_DiveBranchEasyDesc: Less loot, no Black ICE, a quiet trace. Somewhere along it lies a hidden passage.
LanguageData.NR_DiveBranchScanHint: Scan the fork to see the numbers.
LanguageData.NR_DiveBranchTakeTip: Final: there is no way back to the fork. Taking a path costs no action.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogConfession: The confession's back doors are open: every hidden step is visible.
LanguageData.NR_NewsStorm: Data storm: stronger defenses, bigger hauls, {0} left
LanguageData.NR_NewsBossSoon: Rumors: a corporate core surfaces in {0}
LanguageData.NR_NewsCounterHack: Your turrets are held from {0}: dive in to take them back
LanguageData.NR_NewsWildAI: Something stirs in the memory of {0}
LanguageData.NR_GatewayDaemonLocked: Not found yet: daemons come from the corporate core and rare finds.
LanguageData.NR_GatewayDaemonOne: One daemon per dive: picking another swaps it. Free, takes no program slot.
LanguageData.NR_NewsEffectStorm: Data storm: gates and ICE one stronger, hauls {0}
LanguageData.NR_NewsEffectHunters: Your Heat is at Target or higher: ICE hunters may follow you in dives
LanguageData.NR_NewsEffectBoss: A corporate core is open: a boss node with a big haul
LanguageData.NR_NewsEffectPrograms: Programs loaded for the next dive: {0}
LanguageData.NR_NewsEffectConfession: A watched confession: the next dive shows everything hidden
LanguageData.NR_DiveEffectFlow: {0} is in the flow: a day of faster learning and research, hacks land more often.
LanguageData.NR_DiveEffectMemory: {0} brought something back from the net: +{2} XP to {1}.
LanguageData.NR_DiveEffectAdrenaline: {0} survived the ICE and feels unstoppable.
LanguageData.NR_DiveEffectMigraine: {0} has a digital migraine after a long dive.
LanguageData.NR_DiveEffectPhantom: {0} catches phantom signals: the dependency shows ICE in the real world.
LanguageData.NR_DiveEffectBurned: Black ICE burned {0}'s neural link: hacks are harder for three days.
LanguageData.NR_HeadlineLeak: Access codes to «{0}» leaked: its defense dropped by 1.
LanguageData.NR_HeadlineGlut: Data floods the market: dives bring {0} cyberdata for {1} days.
LanguageData.NR_HeadlineQuiet: The net goes quiet: dives leave {0} of the trace for {1} days.
LanguageData.NR_HeadlineLockdown: The corporate core fell. The corps are on lockdown: corp nodes +1 defense for {0} days.
LanguageData.NR_HeadlineRunaway: {0} was seen in «{1}». A dive there may find it.
LanguageData.NR_HeadlineOrbitOpen: A colony gravship is in orbit: the orbital backbone hubs are in reach. Richer data, harder ICE.
LanguageData.NR_HeadlineOrbitClosed: The gravship has landed: the orbital hubs are out of reach again.
LanguageData.NR_NewsEffectLockdown: Corp lockdown: corp nodes have stronger ICE.
LanguageData.NR_DiveActTip_Back: Step back to the previous step, for files left behind. It takes the rest of this turn. You cannot step back out of a branch you chose.
LanguageData.NR_DiveBackFork: The branch is chosen: no way back to the fork.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogBack: Stepped back to {0}. The turn is spent.
LanguageData.NR_LinkLost: Black ICE hit {0} hard enough to burn the {1} out for good. A new one has to be installed.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_0: AD // NeuroNap™ pods: sleep 4 hours, dream 40. Side effects are a myth.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_1: AD // Tired of ICE? Melt it. Sharkfin Breakers, now 20% sharper.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_2: AD // Your memories, our servers. MemoryVault: we never look. Probably.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_3: AD // Synthmeat Deluxe: tastes like the real thing, if you never had the real thing.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_4: AD // Lost a limb? Upgrade it. Kessler Prosthetics, payment plans for the brave.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_5: AD // Join the Glittersworld lottery! Ticket price: one minor organ.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_6: AD // Braindance of the week: "Sunset over a world that still exists". 4.9 stars.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_7: AD // Need a fixer? You don't. You need a friend. FixerFriend™.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_8: RUMOR // A runner swears a node near the rim sings at night. Nobody else hears it.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_9: RUMOR // Someone is selling the source code of a corp core. It is probably a trap.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_10: RUMOR // An AI keeps leaving poems in public archives. Signed: "still here".
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_11: RUMOR // Fixers say the market price of cyberdata will drop. Fixers always say that.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_12: RUMOR // A pirate crew lost a whole ship to a phishing letter. The letter was very polite.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_13: RUMOR // There is a node with no ICE at all. Everyone who found it is very quiet now.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_14: RUMOR // A corp intern left the admin password on a public board. Again.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_15: RUMOR // Somebody recorded a braindance of a mechanoid dreaming. It is just static. Or is it?
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_16: NET // Packet storm off the eastern relay. Expect lag, bad jokes and worse coffee.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_17: NET // Archive-12 is back online after the outage. Its librarian AI is still offended.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_18: NET // A dead satellite started broadcasting again. Only one word, every hour: "wait".
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_19: NET // Market-07 bans the word "discount". Prices unaffected.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_20: NET // The Ancient Danger network sends its regards. Nobody knows how it is still running.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_21: NET // Traffic down 3% while everyone watches the new braindance. Good time to dive.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_22: NET // A honeypot node was caught being honest for a full day. Experts are worried.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_23: CORP // Cobalt Systems denies everything, including things nobody asked about.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_24: CORP // A corp security chief was fired for being too secure. Nobody could log in.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_25: CORP // Quarterly report: profits up, ICE budget up, employee smiles mandatory.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_26: CORP // The corps announce a "transparency initiative". The announcement is encrypted.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_27: STREET // A street kid found a working cyberdeck in the trash. Now the trash has better security.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_28: STREET // Local muffalo herd hacked? No. They just stand near the antenna a lot.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_29: STREET // A runner jacked in for a minute and came back fluent in a dead language.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_30: STREET // "Never trust a fixer who smiles" — every fixer, smiling.
LanguageData.NR_NewsFlavor_31: STREET // Boomalope-powered server farm explodes. Investors call it "a learning experience".
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_1: MOONSHINE-9 neural stims: think faster, sleep never. Side effects are a rumor.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_2: Tired of your old link? Trade-in any cyberdeck at HOLLOW RIDGE SALVAGE. No questions, no receipts.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_3: Your colony deserves better ICE. Warden-Grade™ firewalls: the last thing a raider will ever read.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_4: CHROME KITCHEN: hot meals, cold wafers, and a dead drop in every booth.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_5: Lost a pawn to a dive? Our grief counselors are an AI, but they really, really try.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_6: Static in your head? Dr. Vell's neutroamine clinics: first dose on the house, second on credit.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_7: Sell your memories, keep your dignity! (Dignity not included.)
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_8: GLASS ORCHARD: fresh data grown without pesticides. Certified human-adjacent.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_9: A trace is just a rumor with a timestamp. Quiet Hands Ltd. makes both disappear.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_10: Braindance Palace: feel what it's like to be a pirate lord. Refunds not available after waking.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_11: Need a fixer? Everyone needs a fixer. Ours has a 4.7 rating and only two lawsuits.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_12: ICE-BREAKER pills for your mood. Side effects: confidence, rapid heartbeat, a sudden tax audit.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_13: Rimstone Bank: loans for pirates, no questions. Collateral: your name and one eye.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_14: Sleep is for people who can't afford to be awake. Try WAKEFUL-3.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_15: SIGNAL & SONS: three generations of antenna repair. We never ask what you listen to.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_16: Ghost Mode™: your Heat, but quieter. Not a guarantee. Not legal advice.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_17: Hire a decoy! Our freelancers will be seen in your place. Rates by the hour, scars by the week.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_19: Your AI is lonely. Give it a bedtime story. Premium Narrator pack: 9 silver.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Ad_20: TOWER 13 capsule hotel: a bed, a cable, a lock. The lock is optional.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_1: They say a corp wiped an entire archive node and blamed a squirrel.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_2: Overheard: a runaway AI is renting server space under the name «Totally Not An AI».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_3: A fixer in the south sector paid a debt with a single perfect memory. Nobody knows whose.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_4: Rumor: ICE hunters learned to follow a trace across three dives. Keep your Heat low.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_5: Someone found a door in the net that opens into the middle of a pirate camp. It was not a joke.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_6: They say the old Oracle node still answers, if you ask it nicely and bring a gift.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_7: A courier vanished with a case full of cyberdata. His mother says he was a good boy.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_8: Word on the net: a corp is paying silver for pawns who can sit still in a cyberpod for six hours.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_9: Heard in the dark exchange: «the next storm will hit on a Tuesday.» There are no Tuesdays here.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_10: An AI in the east sector refuses to work weekends. Management is aware.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_11: Somebody is selling the same braindance to three different colonies. It is always the one about the sunset.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_12: They say if you hold a link long enough, you start to hear the net breathe.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_13: A runner swears the Corp core was humming a lullaby. Nobody asked which one.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_14: They say there is a node nobody has ever entered, because every map shows it in a different place.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_15: A pirate band is trying to learn to hack. Reports say the cyberpod ended up in the soup.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_16: The Warden AI of a far colony reportedly gave every raider a polite warning. Twice.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_17: Fixers are quietly buying up old comm consoles. Nobody knows why. Prices rise.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_18: Some say Heat has a memory: it forgives, but only after being asked three times.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_19: A tribe three valleys over put a cyberpod in their temple. It is, reportedly, working.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Rumor_20: A stolen braindance shows a whole market day in the net, with no people. Just the voices.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_1: MERIDIAN DYNAMICS reminds all employees: unauthorized dives are a firing offense. And a legal one.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_2: Quarterly report: security spending up 40%, security incidents up 41%. We are investigating the correlation.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_3: The firm «Kestrel Vault» announces ICE v7.2: now with emotional support.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_4: Notice to residents: the data centre on level 3 is not haunted. Please stop filing tickets.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_5: Corporate hotline: «Your call is important to us. Your data was more important, and it has been sold.»
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_6: Reminder: every mandatory fun event is logged, scored and compared against last year's fun.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_7: Press release: the breach was «a planned stress test of public trust». Trust failed the test.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_8: Lost and found: one neural link, slightly used, one owner, wanted for questioning.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_9: Notice: please stop naming the server room printers. They are not pets.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_10: Security update: all passwords must now be longer than the employee's contract.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_11: MERIDIAN DYNAMICS values your privacy. We keep it in a very safe place, with all the rest.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_12: Internal memo: «cyber» is no longer a word. Please use «digital assets and their friends».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_13: Kestrel Vault reminds clients that its guarantees are guaranteed in the sense of the guarantee.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Corp_14: The break room coffee has been declared a data breach. Investigation ongoing.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_1: The net is quiet tonight. Too quiet. Or the cat is on the cable again.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_2: Black market prices drift up again. Somebody up the chain got greedy.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_3: A runner left three tabs open in a corp node. The corp has noticed.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_4: Packet loss in the south: blamed on weather, solar flares, and a man called Gary.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_5: Free advice: never dive on an empty stomach, and never trust a node that says «welcome back».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_6: The noodle stall at the old node district now accepts cyberdata. Exchange rate: a bowl per shard.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_7: Graffiti found in the cache: «the real ICE was the friends we made.»
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_8: A node somewhere is playing the same eight bars of music on a loop. Nobody can find which one.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_9: The net smells of ozone and cold noodles tonight.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_10: A street musician is playing modem tones for coins. The coins are cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_11: Somebody painted a door on the firewall. Nobody has tried it yet.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_12: Lost: one trace, brown, medium size, answers to «Heat». If found, do not return.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_13: Fixers are in a good mood today. That is never a good sign.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_14: A cleaning drone has been scrubbing the same node for six hours. Nobody has the heart to stop it.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_15: It rains in the net again. Packets hide under the awnings.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Street_16: Overheard in a queue: «I'd sell my soul, but the price of souls has crashed.»
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_1: Chart-topper: «Static Heart» by the Lost Packets. Critics call it «a mood».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_2: New braindance «Last Train To Nowhere» tops the charts. 94% of viewers say they cried; 6% were lying.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_3: Cyber-chess finals tonight: the AI «Rook-7» defends its title against a human who wears the same jacket daily.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_4: Fashion: chrome is out, matte is in, and a single glowing wire behind the ear is «classic».
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_5: Bounty report: three pirates, one mimic, and a surprisingly angry turkey.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_6: The weather in the net: light data drizzle, a chance of corporate fog after midnight.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_7: The Lost Packets announce a farewell tour. Their third. Tickets are cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_8: Cyber-poetry slam: a human vs. three AIs. The human won by crying first.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_9: Weather in the net: ICE showers in the corp quarter, bring a shield.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_10: Review: «Last Train To Nowhere» — a masterpiece, if you like trains. Or nowhere.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_11: Fashion: this season's must-have is one unplugged cable, worn proudly.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Culture_12: Sports: the Rust Devils beat the Hollow Ridge Hackers 6:2 in cyber-polo.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_1: Tip: Heat decays on its own. Scrubbing it is for when you cannot wait.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_2: Tip: a dive without a program is a brave dive. A dive with one is a smart dive.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_3: Tip: fixers remember who paid and who ran. Keep your word, or keep your distance.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_4: Tip: an AI that trusts you will say so. An AI that does not will tell you in other ways.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_5: Tip: Black ICE does not forgive. Read the gate before you touch it.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_6: Tip: take a break. Even runners need a real sky now and then.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_7: Tip: a node with a star wants something. Fixers pay more for what they asked for.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_8: Tip: the Scan action is cheap. Dives without it are for the brave and the lucky.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_9: Tip: an AI in a coprocessor is quieter than an AI on a server. Both listen.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_10: Tip: braindance edits live in the Studio. The comms console just takes the calls.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_11: Tip: if the net feels loud, wait. The net always gets bored first.
LanguageData.NR_Flavor_Tip_12: Tip: Netsick is not weakness. It is a bill, and bills can be paid in sleep.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogAlert: Node alert {0}/{1}: the failed gate was noticed.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogPatrolAwake: Node alert at maximum: an ICE patrol is awake and sweeping the node.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogPatrolShield: The ICE patrol struck: the shield took the hit.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogPatrolStrike: The ICE patrol found {0} and threw them out of the node. Half the haul is lost.
LanguageData.NR_DiveHudAlertTip: Every failed gate hack raises the node alert (ICE failures do not). At {0} an ICE patrol wakes up: each node turn it strikes with a {1} chance. A strike throws the runner out with half the haul and nausea; a shield or Aegis takes it instead.\n\nThe Wraith daemon lets one more failure slip by. Nodes of defense 1 have no alert.
LanguageData.NR_ProgramDesc_IceBreaker: Hacking Expansion black ICE breaker as a program: breaks one gate without a roll, but that action leaves double trace. Burns one ICE breaker, no cyberdata. One HE item per dive.
LanguageData.NR_ProgramDesc_Exec: An exec data run as a program: +1 action in each of the first three turns. Burns one exec data, no cyberdata. One HE item per dive.
LanguageData.NR_HeProgramOnlyOne: Only one Hacking Expansion item per dive.
LanguageData.NR_DiveLogBreaker: The ICE breaker tore through the {0}. Loud: double trace.
LanguageData.NR_DiveCostPodFuel: Paid first from the pod's hack points: {0}
LanguageData.NR_GatewayDaemonHint: Daemons: none yet. They are found in corporate cores and stay with you for every later dive.
LanguageData.NR_PulledOut:
The cyberpod opened while {0} was still out in the net. The link snapped: Netsick, nausea and maybe a lockout, and whatever the run carried is lost.
Next time end the run first: exit the dive, or walk the runner to an exit point or Home.
LanguageData.NR_WakeMidRunConfirm:
{0} is still out in the net. Waking now tears them out: Netsick, nausea, maybe a lockout, and the run is lost.
End the run first (exit the dive, or reach an exit point or Home). Wake anyway?
LanguageData.NR_WakeMidRunTip: The pawn is out in the net: end the run first.
LanguageData.NR_DiveRivalBarTip: Another netrunner is in this node. In {0} turns they take the files that are still here. Where they are in the node is unknown, only their pace.
